{{Quote|For the children. They call these Memily's baskets. I've seen Senator Organa sneak them, too.|Memily, to Ferus Olin|<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception]]''</ref>}}
'''Memily's baskets''' were pastries that were prepared by [[Memily]] in the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Royal Palace]] of [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]] around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. Their name had been invented by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], then toddler [[Prince/Legends|princess]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and her friend [[Winter Celchu|Winter]]. The baskets consisted in small pastry shells filled with chopped [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]]. Although the baskets were intended for the [[Youngling/Legends|children]] of the palace, Memily once noted that even [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], husband to [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha]], was fond of them.
